description: Cleanview's US battery storage tracker lists utility-scale battery projects with name, capacity in megawatts, operational year, state and county location and developer. The page read on 2026-09-29 showed 1,069 operating projects with 53,367 MW of capacity, 190 projects built in 2025 and 150 developers, with filters for each US state and the main grid operators such as CAISO, ERCOT, MISO, PJM, NYISO, ISO-NE and SPP. Cleanview is a commercial energy data company and the page says it was last updated in September 2026, with monthly refreshes. Access is through an interactive map and tables and a documented API; sign-in and paid plans exist and the page states no data licence, only a copyright notice. Caveats: locations are to county level, storage duration is not shown on the page read, and full download terms need a plan. It suits capacity planning, storage siting and grid transition scenario inputs. Related catalogue record: data-battery-charts-germany-stationary-storage covers Germany.
